If you mean the Supreme Court of India, Justice Dalveer Bhandari joined the International Court of Justice (ICJ) on April 27, 2012, and was re-elected for a second term beginning in 2018. (sci.gov.in)
Justice R. S. Pathak, a former Chief Justice of India, also served on the ICJ, from 1989 to 1991. (sci.gov.in)
